ST2.description: Supplementary Table 2 (Table1.XLSX, sheet ST2): the 10 SLC5A2-region instruments for SGLT2 inhibition. Their effects are on HbA1c from UK Biobank ukb-d-30750_irnt (n = 344,182), as tabulated, i.e. HbA1c-raising per effect allele. Methods step 5 inverts these betas to represent SGLT2 inhibition.

Lin2024SGLT2-1.notes: All 10 rows of ST2; the paper uses the same instrument for every PheWAS outcome. The exposure betas are HbA1c-raising as tabulated. The claim estimate (OR 10.95) is ST4 'SGLT2 inhibitor, Endometriosis || id:finn-b-N14_ENDOMETRIOSIS' IVW beta 2.393, which is per unit HbA1c lowering (inverted betas). In the ST2 orientation it corresponds to beta -2.393. There are no per-SNP outcome effects, so no recompute.
